-- Step 1: Add usv column to users table if it doesn't exist
DO $$ 
BEGIN 
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'users' AND column_name = 'usv') THEN
        ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN usv numeric;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Step 2: Update usv with computed values
UPDATE users SET usv = subdays * CASE substatus
    WHEN 'Premium' THEN 2.0
    WHEN 'Enterprise' THEN 3.0
    WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1.0
    ELSE 0.5
END;
